mapper.sql: r.id, r.session_id, r.player_id, r.status, r.waitlist_position, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.name AS player_name, p.phone AS player_phone, p.member_level, sc.name AS script_name, s.start_time AS session_start_time, s.capacity AS capacity, s.status AS session_status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registrations (session_id, player_id, status, waitlist_position, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{playerId}, #{status}, #{waitlistPosition}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.session_id, r.player_id, r.status, r.waitlist_position, r.created_at, r.updated_at, p.name AS player_name, p.phone AS player_phone, p.member_level FROM registrations r JOIN players p ON p.id = r.player_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.status = 'WAITLISTED' ORDER BY r.waitlist_position ASC, r.created_at ASC

SELECT id, session_id, player_id, status, waitlist_position, created_at, updated_at FROM registrations WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAITLISTED' ORDER BY waitlist_position ASC, created_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM registrations r JOIN players p ON p.id = r.player_id JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id JOIN scripts sc ON sc.id = s.script_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'WAITLISTED') ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'REGISTERED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.waitlist_position ASC, r.created_at ASC

SELECT FROM registrations r JOIN players p ON p.id = r.player_id JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id JOIN scripts sc ON sc.id = s.script_id WHERE r.player_id = #{playerId} AND r.status IN ('REGISTERED', 'WAITLISTED') ORDER BY s.start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE registrations SET status = #{status}, waitlist_position = #{waitlistPosition}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registrations SET status = 'REGISTERED', waitlist_position = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE registrations SET status = 'CANCELLED', waitlist_position = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('REGISTERED', 'WAITLISTED')
UPDATE registrations SET status = 'CANCELLED', waitlist_position = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'WAITLISTED'
